name: Self Abuse
overview: Scripture calls believers to turn from sin and self-destructive behaviors by confessing and forsaking them, promising mercy to those who do so rather than covering their sins. Christians are exhorted to consider themselves dead to sin and alive in Christ, embracing the freedom He provides and resisting the bondage of sinful patterns. The call to mortify earthly desires and be filled with the Spirit highlights the necessity of relying on Christ’s strength to overcome self-abuse and live in holiness.
